04/19/2026

Attempt to run an example of the new codebase

```{r}
library(gcKrig)

grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
locs <- expand.grid(x = grid, y = grid)

mu <- exp(1 + 0.5 * locs$x + locs$y)

set.seed(321)

sim_h18b <- simgc(
  locs = as.matrix(locs),
  sim.n = 1,
  marginal = negbin.gc(mu = mu, od = 1),
  corr = matern.gc(range = 0.3, kappa = 0.5, nugget = 0)
)
```
